subject: Proposal: Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance

Team —

Attached is a proposal I sketched this morning: "Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance." High level goals: reduce cross-team handoffs, clarify ownership for product+runtime pairings, and create a 2-tier manager band to reduce span-of-control pressure on senior ICs transitioning to first-time managers.

Key changes (short):
- Create Tier A (core product pods) and Tier B (growth/platform squads). Tier A gets tighter SLA/throughput alignment and a smaller, more senior manager span (6-8 heads). Tier B remains leaner (8-12) focused on rapid experimentation and cost optimization.
- Consolidate runtime & infra product ownership into three cross-functional pods instead of five separate owners — improves deployment velocity and reduces duplicated infra effort.
- Introduce "Lead Engineer" role to bridge senior ICs who take on 1:1s for smaller teams (reduces immediate manager hiring).

Requested next steps:
1) Feedback on scope and obvious operational risks by EOD Friday.
2) If ok, I'll loop People Ops and Legal to draft communication and individual outreach plan.
3) We should prepare a headcount impact model for the October planning cycle.

Attachments: tiered_squads_rationale_v1.pdf, role_scope_matrix.xlsx, headcount_impact_model.csv (stubs attached)

Notes: This is a working draft meant to start conversation — I've highlighted roles that will require sensitive handling (re-banding, potential partial-role consolidations).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance

Aditya — thanks for the clear draft. A few quick questions: 
- Can you add a short table mapping current squads -> proposed tier and manager? Right now the document is conceptual and that'll help me translate to roadmaps.
- Headcount impact: are you expecting net increase, neutral, or net decrease at the org level? I want to understand 6-12 month hiring cadence implications.
- Risks: any single points of failure if we consolidate runtime owners (on-call load, deploy windows)?

Happy to discuss on Friday if that helps.

—Marcus
Director, Compute Platform

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance

Quick operational flags from runtime side: 
- Consolidating owners reduces context switching, but we must preserve per-model SLO accountability. Suggest a lightweight "runtime SLA owner" role per Tier A pod (rotating) so SLAs and rollout fallbacks are clearly owned.
- KV cache and model routing are common pain points — need explicit migration playbooks for teams that will lose direct ownership.
- Quantization/benchmarking needs to be part of the role_scope_matrix.xlsx — otherwise teams will unconsciously choose different perf targets.

I can sketch the SLA owner rotation and add a migration appendix to the matrix if you want.

—Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: People Operations - TalentBridge <peopleops@talentbridge.com>, Claudia Harper - Harper & Co Legal <claudia.harper@harperlegal.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance

Thanks for the rapid feedback — useful points. I uploaded an updated role_scope_matrix.xlsx that includes the SLA owner concept and a high-level mapping table (current squad -> tier). Headcount model now flags three scenarios: neutral, modest reband (no net decrease), and consolidation (net -4 over 6 months). See headcount_impact_model.csv.

People Ops / Claudia — could you please advise on two things: 
1) Communication approach for people in scope for rebanding vs potential role consolidation (confidential one-to-one then team announcement vs simultaneous)? My leaning is to do confidential 1:1s with impacted managers first, then a public comms event 48 hours later.
2) Draft timeline: we need a safe process for offers/changes that affects comp bands and title changes; let's ensure legal review for any re-lettering or change of terms.

Proposed immediate timeline if approved by leadership:
- Week 1: Leadership sign-off on tier mapping and headcount scenario selection.
- Week 2: People Ops prepares 1:1 outreach bundles and revised job descriptions.
- Week 3: Manager 1:1s with impacted ICs / reband letters sent.
- Week 4: Public announcement + updated team pages.

If this timeline looks tight, say so — I'd rather push and do it cleanly.

Aditya

From: People Operations - TalentBridge <peopleops@talentbridge.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Claudia Harper - Harper & Co Legal <claudia.harper@harperlegal.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance

Thanks for the ping, Aditya. We reviewed the attachments and can support the proposed timeline with a few conditions: 
- We need the finalized headcount_impact_model.csv with clear per-person outcomes (reband vs role removal vs redeploy) by EOD Wednesday (17 Sep). Please mark any roles that carry regulatory or contract constraints.
- For confidentiality, we recommend the 1:1-first approach. People Ops will provide individualized outreach bundles (talking points, comp guidance, reband letter template).
- Legal flagged two template clauses that need review for re-lettering and consent where comp/bonus structures change. Claudia will follow up with redlines.

Proposed support plan: we can run manager training next Monday (mock 1:1s) and produce the public comms deck once letters are finalized.

People Ops (TalentBridge)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: People Operations - TalentBridge <peopleops@talentbridge.com>, Claudia Harper - Harper & Co Legal <claudia.harper@harperlegal.com>, Max Brown <max.brown@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 22:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Tiered Product Squads and Manager Band Rebalance — leadership sign-off request

Team —

Summary / decisions to date: 
- We will proceed with the Tier A / Tier B model and implement the SLA owner rotation as Karthik proposed.
- Headcount scenario selected: modest reband (no net headcount reduction) for the October hire plan; this minimizes disruption while we validate workload consolidation.
- People Ops and Legal will own packaging and manager 1:1s; People Ops to deliver final bundles tomorrow (18 Sep).

Immediate asks: 
- Marcus: please confirm that on-call/incident rotations are covered under the SLA owner plan and share any shift implications by EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik: please add a short migration playbook appendix to role_scope_matrix.xlsx with rollback checkpoints.
- Neha & Soojin: draft the manager training checklist (mock 1:1 agenda + FAQ) and share with People Ops.

I'll schedule a 45-minute leadership sync Friday to lock comms and final timings. Thanks for quick turnaround here — this is sensitive; please avoid broader distribution until letters are ready.

—Aditya
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
